rv.q: With a book by Emerald Fennell, who won an Oscar for the screenplay of Promising Young Woman, this reboot of the story, starring Carrie Hope Fletcher, delivers a 21st-century take on romance. And it's simply joyous. We all know Lloyd Webber can do portentous.
Cinderella is a triumph of catchy songs and fabulous wigs - it shouldn't be denied to a joy-starved public.

But the ambition in taking on one of the most loved fairytales of all, one we’re pretty much born knowing, and reconstructing it for the 21st century, is lost in a book that cannot resolve the contradictions inherent in its avowed iconoclasm.

cn.t: Lloyd Webber's sassy fairy tale reinvention earns mixed-to-positive reviews, with critics praising Carrie Hope Fletcher's powerhouse performance and the show's witty, contemporary edge, though some find the material inconsistent.
